mechanism: Tolterodine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and CYP3A4; hydrocortisone may modestly inhibit CYP3A4 and alter anticholinergic effects, while corticosteroids can increase urinary retention risk in anticholinergic therapy.
action: Monitor for anticholinergic adverse effects (urinary retention, constipation, dry mouth) and consider dose adjustment if symptoms emerge; assess baseline urinary function.
